verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO Keys are hardware authenticators (FIDO2/U2F, PIV, OTP) with small management utilities such as SK Manager. They hold no user data to analyze, so AI-generated insights from user data is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI or analytics capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
